title: Duuk's Dungeons
description: I made Hypixel Skyblock more accessible.
body:
I hope you enjoy low-strain gaming with my resource pack <3

I'm a visually impaired Hypixel Skyblock enjoyer. I spent way too much time searching for a resource pack that fit my needs for something that reduced the vibrancy of default Minecraft. Nothing was working well for my disability so I decided to start making my own. I'm 3 years into slow, casual development and enough people have liked it so I decided to finally start posting my progress here :)
## Features
### Dark Mode
Replaces the default overly-vibrant textures of Minecraft with muted dark tones without losing integrity of the game.

Key items, blocks and entities are modified to stand out against dark backgrounds without becoming overly bright or overly dark.

Helps reduce the risk of migraines and headaches that normal packs and default Minecraft can cause.

Some of my favorite textures:
- Short pointy swords
- Brighter leather armor so we can see our dyes better
- CROWNS on armor that isn't leather
- Pink/purple color changing lava and fire

## Dependencies
With the recent forced resource pack from Hypixel, I've had to rework my pack a few times to make everything work without retexturing every item in the game.

Required mods will be automatically installed when you download the pack. Scroll to the bottom of the version you want to install if you want any of the optional mods.
### Required Mods
[Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis) lets me create custom textures.
[PackDisabler for Hypixel Skyblock](https://modrinth.com/mod/packdisabler-for-hypixel-skyblock) turns off the Hypixel Skyblock resource pack.
### Optional
[Skyboxify](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyboxify) if you care about the custom skybox.

#### This project is still in development
Feel free to leave comments and suggestions in my Discord!
